cohort: 100 COVID-19 positive pregnant women with ASA physical class II, III, and IV who underwent lower segment emergency caesarean section at a tertiary teaching hospital in Karnataka, India, between April 1st and July 31st, 2021.
finding: Overall maternal mortality rate was 5% (5/100), one woman had HELLP syndrome, one experienced postpartum hemorrhage (PPH), and eight neonates required NICU admission with APGAR scores less than 7.
